gaps.title: Material search missing pagination in UI
gaps.jtbd: When viewing material search results, I want to paginate through results, so that large catalogs don't overwhelm the browser
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search result with many materials, When I look at the UI, Then I should see pagination controls to navigate through pages
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: A public list/search endpoint usually needs pagination, as mentioned in the guidelines. The ProtocolSearch UI has pagination controls, but MaterialSearch.svelte lacks pagination logic and controls completely.
